decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds on the firm's core market-data assets, has its own page, and fits the announced platform direction, so management still treats slow uptake as a ramp-up issue and persists.
The gas tariff comparison runs on existing databases at low maintenance cost and is publicly presented, so withdrawing it would mean writing off sunk effort for little savings.

The electricity tariff calculator is core-adjacent and visibly presented, and it strengthens the central platform, so management stays committed even though it may overlap with the withdrawn regional energy calculator line.
The area definition tool underpins the firm's other location-based products and the platform, so dropping it would undercut related investments that management feels obliged to justify.

The site-specific comparison line has only modest web visibility and overlaps with other tariff tools, but the investment in several models and its fit with the core business still argue for keeping it.
